notes.title: School Years update announcement
notes.notes:
Dear players, in order to give you a better game experience.

The update reads as follows:

I. Price changes
"School Years" original 11 yuan will be permanently changed to 38 yuan.

Ii. Follow-up plan
Optimization part: All roles will be optimized later
Fix bugs: fix bugs that still exist, but also hope that players actively provide BUG feedback oh ~

3. Activities with prizes
This game supports Steam creative workshop, you can actively participate! Upload your own work and make stories etc. There will be a prize activity at the creative Workshop in the near future (be sure to participate actively, you will be the next winner)

notes.title: English Language Patch
notes.notes:
I have been trying my best to do the localization work recently and happily to announce that  English is available in the game now. 
日本語バージョンは鋭意製作中です。

初恋日记(School Years) is a visual novel adapted from a real story . In this game you will experience the life of a high school student in China, who met his first love before graduation and went through many many things in that year...

As I am not English major, If you find any mistakes, I would be very grateful if you could contact me and help me to fix them.

Hope you will like my story and welcome to to share your thoughts on Steam.
